title: transport.setLoop
description: Sets the loop flag of OpenTune's transport bar. OpenTune Standalone has no loop range, so the flag has no audible effect: a call that turns the flag on carries the warning LOOP_NO_EFFECT_STANDALONE. The flag is not saved with the project (warning NOT_PERSISTED) and the project is not marked as changed; it is view state (PROTOCOL.md section 15.2 rule 6) with the undo reason not_persisted_state, and the revert recipe sets the previous value. Setting the current value is a no-op. changes lists the transport (entity transport, member loopEnabled), and transport is the transport state after the call.
